mapper.select: SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, fa.owner_type, fa.owner_member_id, fa.child_id, fa.balance, fa.balance_updated_at FROM financial_account fa LEFT JOIN child c ON c.child_id = fa.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( fa.owner_type = 'PARENT' OR ( fa.owner_type = 'CHILD' AND c.child_id IS NOT NULL ) )

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, fa.owner_type, fa.owner_member_id, fa.child_id, c.name AS child_name, fa.organization_code, fa.bank_name, fa.account_name, fa.account_number_ciphertext, fa.account_product_type, fa.balance, fa.balance_updated_at, fa.account_status, fa.is_primary AS primary_account, fa.opened_at, fa.maturity_date, fa.linked_at, fa.goal_name_snapshot, fa.goal_target_amount, fa.goal_target_date FROM financial_account fa LEFT JOIN child c ON c.child_id = fa.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( fa.owner_type = 'PARENT' OR ( fa.owner_type = 'CHILD' AND c.child_id IS NOT NULL ) )

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, fa.organization_code, fa.bank_name, fa.account_name, fa.account_number_ciphertext, fa.account_product_type, fa.balance, fa.balance_updated_at, fa.account_status, fa.is_primary AS primary_account FROM financial_account fa WHERE fa.owner_member_id = #{memberId} AND fa.owner_type = 'PARENT' AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY fa.is_primary DESC, fa.linked_at DESC, fa.financial_account_id DESC

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, fa.organization_code, fa.bank_name, fa.account_name, fa.account_number_ciphertext, fa.account_product_type, fa.balance, fa.balance_updated_at, fa.account_status, fa.is_primary AS primary_account FROM financial_account fa WHERE fa.owner_type = 'CHILD' AND fa.child_id = #{childId} AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY fa.is_primary DESC, fa.linked_at DESC, fa.financial_account_id DESC

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS account_id, c.child_id, fa.child_access_mode AS child_usage_mode, fa.child_available_amount AS child_monthly_budget_amount FROM child c INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = c.member_id INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.child_id = c.child_id AND fa.owner_type = 'CHILD' WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'CHILD' AND fa.account_product_type = 'DEMAND_DEPOSIT' AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY fa.linked_at DESC, fa.financial_account_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT child_id FROM child WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
